ideas.children_he: נֹחַ נִכְנַס לַתֵּבָה עוֹד לִפְנֵי שֶׁהַגֶּשֶׁם הִתְחִיל. לִפְעָמִים צָרִיךְ לְהִתְכּוֹנֵן לְסַכָּנָה גַּם כְּשֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא רוֹאִים אוֹתָהּ.
ideas.children_en: God told Noah to enter the Ark with his family because he was righteous. They should take pairs of clean and unclean animals, including birds. The flood will start in seven days. Noah obeyed God before the flood began.

ideas.children_he: הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה וּבַעֲלֵי הַחַיִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ בַּתֵּבָה. כְּשֶׁמְּשַׁתְּפִים פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְמוֹדֵד עִם אֶתְגָּרִים גְּדוֹלִים.
ideas.children_en: Noah, his family, and animals entered the Ark before the flood. The animals came on their own, both clean and unclean. After seven days, the flood waters began.

ideas.children_he: הַגֶּשֶׁם יָרַד אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְלַיְלָה. בְּתוֹךְ הַסַּכָּנָה הַתֵּבָה הָיְתָה מָקוֹם מוּגָן לְנֹחַ וּלְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: On a special day, the floodwaters came from below and heavy rain fell for forty days and nights. All animals and family entered pairs to the Ark. God closed the Ark to keep them safe.

ideas.children_he: הַמַּיִם עָלוּ וְהַתֵּבָה צָפָה מֵעֲלֵיהֶם. לִפְעָמִים צָרִיךְ לְהַמְתִּין בְּסַבְלָנוּת עַד שֶׁהַסַּכָּנָה תַּעֲבֹר.
ideas.children_en: After forty days of flood, the Ark floated on waters covering all mountains. The water was higher than the mountains.

ideas.children_he: הַמַּבּוּל הָיָה אָסוֹן גָּדוֹל, וְרַק מִי שֶׁהָיָה בַּתֵּבָה נִצַּל. הַסִּפּוּר מַזְכִּיר כַּמָּה הַחַיִּים יְקָרִים וְחָשׁוּב לִשְׁמֹר עֲלֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: All life on land died in the flood except Noah and those with him in the Ark. The waters stayed for 150 days, and only the Ark floated on the water.
